The podium is grey-beige stone with a tall glazed retail floor under a canopy line and windows above, instead of five blue-and-cream stripes (panoramas at 47.613977, -122.198816 and NE 4th / 106th).
remainingGaps: Individual balconies, crown facets, rooftop plant and facade bay changes remain simplified.
Podium floor-to-floor conversion and facade palette retain prior estimates.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13).
